description:
HushTelegram v0.0.27 targets Telegram 13.3.1, both telegram.org's build (org.telegram.messenger.web, version code 73469) and the Google Play build (org.telegram.messenger, version code 73461), with 81 patches. Plus Messenger 13.2.2.1 takes 78 of them. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. New: a duress passcode, V2Ray-style servers, folder tabs at the bottom, videos in another player, settings in Italian and an Enter your API ID button when Telegram turns the app's ID down. Unlock Premium features is gone. Before release, 3094 runtime tests passed and 793 patch tests passed, and both patched 13.3.1 builds were walked signed in with no crashes. Needs Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer.

### What's new

* **Telegram:** When Telegram turns down the app's API ID at sign-in, the message now has an **Enter your API ID** button. Type the `App api_id` and `App api_hash` from my.telegram.org/apps and Telegram restarts and asks for the login code with them, so there's no repatching. The pair stays on the phone, out of settings exports and reports, and **Remove** in the same box goes back to the app's own ID. (#107, #111)
* **Telegram:** **Duress passcode** is a new switch in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, off by default. It needs a Telegram passcode. Pick a second code in **Set duress passcode**, and if someone ever makes you unlock Telegram, type that code instead of your real one. **What the duress passcode does** picks what happens next: log out every account (the default), log out only the open one, delete every account, or delete only the open one. Pick a deleting choice and a warning pops up, and it stays written under the row for as long as that choice is set. Typed the first time, the code looks like a wrong passcode and nothing happens yet. Typed again, the accounts are deleted for good, and an account with a cloud password, which Telegram waits a week to delete, is logged out meanwhile. Either way HushTelegram clears what it kept, like deleted messages, edit history and call recordings, and Telegram's downloaded media goes too. With every account gone, Telegram opens on its sign-in screen. When only the open account goes, the lists that hide or arrange your other accounts' chats stay. Your real passcode still unlocks as usual, and only a salted hash of the duress code is stored, never the code itself. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **V2Ray-style servers** is a new switch with **Free proxies** in Chat list, off by default. Paste vmess://, vless://, trojan:// and ss:// links into **Your V2Ray links** and Telegram connects through the fastest of your servers that answers, by way of a small proxy that runs inside Telegram with one entry in Telegram's proxy list. Links in **Your proxy lists** count too, base64 subscriptions included. **V2Ray server** shows how each one did, lets you pick one and tests them all again. VMess, VLESS and Trojan work over TCP or WebSocket, with or without TLS, and Shadowsocks with aes-128-gcm, aes-256-gcm or chacha20-ietf-poly1305. Links that need REALITY, XTLS, gRPC, QUIC, Hysteria, dnstt or Shadowsocks 2022 are skipped, and the row says which kinds it left out. Turning it off takes its entry out of the list and leaves your other proxies alone. Calls don't go through it. (#71)
* **Telegram:** A switch that's new since you last opened HushTelegram settings gets a small dot after its name, and so does the closed section it's in, so you can see what an update added without reading every page. Open the section and the dot moves to the new switch. Close it again, or close the settings, and the dots are gone. Search shows no dots. Nothing shows a dot the first time the settings open after you install, so the first dots come with the update after the one that adds them. (#96)
* **Telegram:** Plus Messenger can be patched too. Pick Plus Messenger 13.2.2.1 (`org.telegram.plus`, version code 22710, the APKMirror download with all four architectures) in Morphe Manager and it offers 78 of the 81 patches, each one read against Plus's own build. Plus keeps its own package, so it installs beside a patched Telegram. (#7)
* **Telegram:** View-once and self-destructing photos and videos get three new options, all off by default. **Show view-once and timed media unblurred** (Reveal spoilers) takes the blur off them in the chat. **Also allow screenshots of view-once and timed media** (Add Repeat to the message menu) lets you capture the screen that opens them, and a secret chat needs **Also allow screenshots in secret chats** as well. With **Also save view-once and timed media** on, the message menu's **Save to Downloads** shows up on them too, even when Telegram only keeps the encrypted file. (#82)
* **Telegram:** Folder tabs can now sit at the bottom of the chat list, right above the bottom bar, so they're easy to reach with one hand. Turn on **Folder tabs at the bottom** in HushTelegram settings > Chat list. It starts off, and it isn't available on Plus Messenger. (#97)
* **Telegram:** Videos in chats can now open in another player like VLC or MX Player. Turn on **Play videos in another app** in HushTelegram settings > Playback. Videos you haven't downloaded stream as they play, so there's no need to save them first, and secret, view-once and protected videos stay in Telegram's player. It starts off. (#99)
* **Telegram:** New **Always show translate bar** switch on the Conversations page, off by default. The translate bar now shows up in chats where Telegram didn't spot another language, which helps with things like Hindi typed in Latin letters. Without Premium it works through **Translate with an outside service**. If **Hide translate bar** is on too, the bar stays hidden. (#98)
* **Telegram:** New **Add Send photo to the link preview menu** switch on the Conversations page, off by default. It comes with Add Repeat to the message menu. When a link preview in the message box has a picture, its menu gets a Send photo row that sends the picture as a normal photo. Your text goes with it as the caption if it fits, otherwise it stays in the box. (#101)
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram's settings speak Italian now. Switch Telegram to Italian and every HushTelegram page, switch, search result and message follows. (#100)
* **Telegram:** New **Hide Downloads button** switch on the Chat list page, off by default. The Downloads button no longer pops up in the bar at the top of the chat list while a file downloads, and your downloads are still in the Downloads tab when you search. (#113)
* **Telegram:** New **Always show Downloads button** switch on the Chat list page, off by default. The Downloads button stays in the bar at the top of the chat list even when nothing is downloading, so your downloads are one tap away. It still steps aside while you search, and turning the switch off takes it away again without a restart. If **Hide Downloads button** is on too, the button stays hidden. Both Downloads switches take hold as soon as you close HushTelegram settings. (#113)
* **Telegram:** New **Keep downloaded stickers** switch on the Look and feel page, off by default. Telegram's automatic cache cleanup leaves sticker files alone, so sticker packs you've used don't have to download again. Clearing the cache yourself still removes them. (#110)
* **Telegram:** New **Sticker panel size** row on the Look and feel page, set to Telegram's size until you change it. Large and Larger show fewer, bigger stickers in the sticker panel and in its search results. A chat picks up a new size the next time you open it. (#110)
* **Telegram:** New **Keep emoji statuses moving** switch on the Ads page, off by default. Animated emoji statuses next to names keep playing instead of stopping after two plays, which uses a little more battery. Restart Telegram after you change it. (#112)
* **Telegram:** New **Rename on this phone** switch on the Look and feel page under **Special contacts**, off by default. It adds **Rename on this phone** to a profile's three dots menu and to the chat list's long press menu, so you can give a person, bot, group or channel a name that only your phone shows. The name shows in place of theirs in the chat list, in chats and on profiles right away, with no restart. Leave the field empty or tap **Remove** to get Telegram's name back. Telegram never gets the name. Anything you send that would carry it, like a mention, adding someone to contacts or sharing a contact, goes out with the real name, and contacts Telegram saves to your phone's address book get the real name too. Your own accounts can't be renamed, up to 50 names fit, and the names go along in a settings file. (#104)
* **Telegram:** New **Open Saved Messages on its media** switch on the Chat list page under **Hide folder tab counters**, off by default. Tapping Saved Messages in the chat list then opens its shared media page, with your saved chats, media, files, links, music and voice messages in tabs. To get to the chat itself, tap the menu on the Chats tab and pick **View as Messages**. Putting Saved Messages in a folder needs no switch, since a folder's **Add Chats** list already has it. (#103)
* **Telegram:** With **Bypass channel restrictions** on, forwarding a protected video or photo you haven't downloaded yet works better. Videos that come in several qualities were waiting on the wrong file and never went out. A download that stops now starts again, a stuck forward no longer holds up the next one, and HushTelegram tells you when it's downloading first and when the download fails. Photos that aren't on your phone download too, and **Save to Downloads** finds the quality you're watching. (#84)
* **Telegram:** **Hide pinned message bar** now reaches a chat left open under HushTelegram settings as soon as the settings close. That chat used to keep its old bar until you left the app or opened the chat again. (#85)
* **Telegram:** Patching for a root mount in Morphe Manager now starts with Repair Firebase push registration off. A mount keeps Telegram's own certificate, which is the thing that patch stands in for. You can still turn it on, and every other install starts with it on as before.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram now patches Telegram 13.3.1, telegram.org's build (version code 73469) and the Google Play build (73461). Plus Messenger stays on 13.2.2.1.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram now builds on Morphe patcher 2.5.0, the one in Morphe Manager 2.7.0 and morphe-desktop 2.3.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.7.0 or newer before you add this release.
* **Telegram:** Remove the Unlock Premium features patch.
* **Telegram:** Remove the **Add Save to Gallery to stories** switch from Add Repeat to the message menu.
* **Telegram:** Remove the **Emoji status on this phone** switch from Hide Premium, gifts and Stars.
* **Telegram:** Remove the **Unlock Premium app icons** switch from Hide Premium, gifts and Stars.
* **Telegram:** Remove the **Move All Chats** switch from Hide folder tab counters.
* **Telegram:** Remove the **Pin chats on this phone** switch from Hide folder tab counters.
